notes: Positions are null as requested. Piece counts match the 168-piece parts list exactly (63 lines).

The three remaining separate groups are real. The booklet's overview page (page 2) and the final page show three things that are not attached to each other: (1) the 4WD, trailer and rear light board, which are joined by the towball hitch (b15 to b111) and the clips (b156/b157 to b109/b110); (2) the horse with its saddle (b1-b4); (3) the white fence (b166-b168). The horse and fence are free-standing accessories, so nothing in the booklet connects them to the vehicles. I have kept them separate rather than invent a connection.

Earlier fixes kept: b99 rests only on the plate b97, because the red grille tile b98 has no studs. The trans-red plate b116 rests on plate b108, not on grille tile b114. The sticker sheet b26 is joined to the pieces it is applied to.

Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, hair, helmet) and the two red 1x1 side-stud bricks (element 4170375) in the booklet are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded as pieces. The trans-red 1x1 plates meant to sit on those side studs are recorded with rests_on [] plus other_joins to the trans-orange slopes.
The brown 1x2 brick and tile (b2, b3) on the horse are removed before the saddle (b4) is fitted. They are still listed because they are in the inventory.
The booklet pictures are small, so which piece sits on which in some steps (side slopes, roof panels, rear lights) is my best reading. The type, colour and count of every piece are exact.
The car's 4x6 flat roof is read as two 2x6 plates resting on a curved roof piece (second 52031) and the window panels. The hood is the first 52031.
Bar 30374 (b85, b86) is held in the roof clips 2555, and the wheels are 6014b inside 6015 tyres on the 4488 wheel-holder plates.
The trans-red 1x1 plates are divided 4 on the car, 4 on the trailer and 2 on the rear light board. The booklet does not clearly show how many go where.
